Nugget: A nugget of pure gold that gives off a lustrous gleam. It can be sold at a high price.

Old Amber: A piece of amber that contains the genes of an ancient Pokémon. It is clear with a reddish tint.

Orbeetlite: Have Orbeetle hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.

PP Up: Slightly raises the maximum PP of a selected move for one Pokémon.
Paralyze Heal: A spray-type medicine. It heals one Pokémon from paralysis.
Passho Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Water-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Water hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Payapa Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Psychic-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Psychic hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Pearl: A relatively small pearl that sparkles in a pretty silver color. It can be sold cheaply.
Pecha Berry: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to cure poison.

Persim Berry: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to lift confusion.
Petaya Berry: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Sp. Atk stat in a pinch.
At 1/4 max HP or less, raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Pidgeotite: Have Pidgeot hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Pikanium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Pikachu's Volt Tackle to a Z-Move.

Pikashunium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades a Thunderbolt by Pikachu in a cap to a Z-Move.
Once per battle for the team, cap-wearing Pikachu's Thunderbolt becomes 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt: 195-power Electric damage with +2 critical-hit stages. Not used up.
Pinap Berry: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.
Pink Nectar: A flower nectar obtained at Royal Avenue. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Pinsirite: Have Pinsir hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Pixie Plate: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a stone tablet that boosts the power of Fairy-type moves.
Fairy moves do 1.2× damage. With Multitype, also makes Arceus and Judgment Fairy type.
Poison Barb: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A small, poisonous barb that boosts the power of Poison-type moves.
Poisonium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Poison-type moves to Z-Moves.
Once per battle for the team, turns a Poison attack into Acid Downpour (power depends on the move), or adds a Poison status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Poké Ball: A Ball thrown to catch a wild Pokémon. It is designed in a capsule style.
Catch rate ×1: the standard catch rate.
Poké Flute: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any Pokémon. It has a lovely tone.
Wakes all sleeping Pokémon in battle, including the opponent. Reusable.
Poké Rider: A device that enables you to fly to locations you've already visited.
Poké Vial: The PokéVial restores your party entirely.
Potion: A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.
Power Anklet: A Pokémon held item that promotes Speed gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.
Power Band: A Pokémon held item that promotes Special Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.
Power Belt: A Pokémon held item that promotes Defense gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.
Power Bracer: A Pokémon held item that promotes Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.
Power Herb: A single-use item to be held by a Pokémon. It allows a charging move on the first turn immediate usage.
Skips the charging turn of a two-turn move, including Geomancy. Used up; does not skip Solar Beam's bad-weather damage penalty.
Power Lens: A Pokémon held item that promotes Special Attack gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.
Power Weight: A Pokémon held item that promotes HP gain on leveling, but reduces the Speed stat.
Primarium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Primarina's Sparkle Aria to a Z-Move.
Once per battle for the team, Primarina's Sparkling Aria becomes Oceanic Operetta: 195-power Water damage. Not used up.
Prism Scale: A mysterious scale that evolves certain Pokémon. It shines in rainbow colors.
Prison Bottle: A bottle believed to have been used to seal away the power of a certain Pokémon long, long ago.
Protective Pads: An item that protects the holder from effects caused by making direct contact with the enemy.
Prevents contact-triggered effects against the holder, such as Rocky Helmet damage, Static and King's Shield's Attack drop.
Protein: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Attack stat of one Pokémon.
Psychic Seed: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts Sp. Defense on Psychic Terrain. It can only be used once.
In Psychic Terrain, raises Sp. Def by 1 stage, even if airborne. Used up; the boost remains after the terrain ends.
Psychium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Psychic-type moves to Z-Moves.
Once per battle for the team, turns a Psychic attack into Shattered Psyche (power depends on the move), or adds a Psychic status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Punching Glove: A held item that boosts the power of punching moves and prevents direct contact with targets.
Punching moves do 1.1× damage and no longer make contact, avoiding effects such as Rocky Helmet and Static.
Purple Nectar: A flower nectar obtained at Poni Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Quick Ball: A Ball that provides a better catch rate if it is used at the start of a wild encounter.
Catch rate ×5 on the first turn of a wild battle, ×1 afterward.
Rare Candy: A candy that is packed with energy. It raises the level of a Pokémon by one.
Rawst Berry: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to heal a burn.
Razz Berry: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.
Reaper Cloth: A special cloth to be held by a Dusknoir. Moves used by the held Pokémon cannot miss.
Held by Dusknoir: its moves never miss.
Red Card: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit by an attack, the attacker is removed from battle.
After surviving a damaging move, forces the attacker into a random teammate. Used up; waits until all hits finish and can stop U-turn or Volt Switch choosing its switch.
Red Nectar: A flower nectar obtained at Ula'ula Meadow. It changes the form of certain species of Pokémon.
Red Orb: An orb that glows red. It is said to contain an incredible power from ancient times.
Red Shard: A small red shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.
Repeat Ball: A somewhat different Ball that works especially well on Pokémon caught before.
Catch rate ×3.5 if the target's species is already marked caught in your Pokédex, ×1 otherwise.
Repel: Prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 100 steps.
Reveal Glass: A glass that reveals the truth. It's a mysterious glass that returns a Pokémon to its original shape.
Revive: A medicine that revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring HP by half the maximum amount.
Rindo Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Grass-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Grass hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Rock Gem: A gem with an essence of rock. When held, it strengthens the power of a Rock-type move once.
The first damaging Rock move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up.
Rockium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Rock-type moves to Z-Moves.
Once per battle for the team, turns a Rock attack into Continental Crush (power depends on the move), or adds a Rock status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Rocky Helmet: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder is hit, the attacker will also be damaged upon contact.
Each contact hit costs the attacker 1/6 of its own max HP. Triggers on every hit of a multi-hit move; Magic Guard prevents the damage.
Roseli Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Fairy-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Fairy hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Rusty Shield: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a disaster in ancient times, but it has since worn out.
Rusty Sword: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a disaster in ancient times, but it has since worn out.
S.S. Ticket: The ticket required for sailing on the ferry S.S. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.
Sablenite: Have Sableye hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Sacred Ash: Revives all fainted Pokémon, restoring HP fully.
Safety Goggles: These goggles protect the holder from both weather-related damage and powder.
Blocks powder moves, Effect Spore and weather damage from sandstorm and hail.
Salac Berry: When held by a Pokémon, it raises the Speed stat in a pinch.
At 1/4 max HP or less, raises Speed by 1 stage. Gluttony triggers it at 1/2 HP instead. Eaten once.
Salamencite: Have Salamence hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Sandacondite: Have Sandaconda hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Sceptilite: Have Sceptile hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Scizorite: Have Scizor hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Scope Lens: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A lens that boosts the critical-hit ratio of the holding Pokémon.
Raises the holder's critical-hit rate by 1 stage.
Secret Key: The key to Cinnabar Island Gym's front door. It is colored red and decorated.
Sharp Beak: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A long, sharp beak that boosts the power of Flying-type moves.
Sharpedonite: Have Sharpedo hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Shed Shell: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This carapace enables the holder to switch out of battle without fail.
Lets the holder switch out despite trapping moves or abilities. Does not let it flee from wild battles.
Shell Bell: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon regains some HP upon striking the foe.
After a damaging move, restores 1/8 of the total damage dealt, including all hits and targets. Does not trigger on a Sheer Force-boosted move.
Shiny Charm: A shiny charm said to increase the chance of finding a Shiny Pokémon.
Shiny Stone: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It shines with a dazzling light.
Shuca Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Ground-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Ground hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Silk Scarf: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A sumptuous scarf that boosts the power of Normal-type moves.
Silph Scope: A scope that makes unseeable Pokémon visible. It is made by Silph Co.
SilverPowder: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A shiny silver powder that boosts the power of Bug-type moves.
Sitrus Berry: When held by a Pokémon, it will be used in battle to restore 25% HP.
Eaten when the holder drops to 1/2 HP or less: restores 1/4 of its max HP. Once.
Slowbronite: Have Slowbro hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Smoke Ball: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holding Pokémon can flee from any wild Pokémon for sure.
Lets the holder flee from wild battles, even through trapping. Does not let it switch out of trapping.
Smooth Rock: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sandstorm when used by the holder.
Sandstorm started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Snorlaxite: Have Snorlax hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Snorlium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Snorlax's Giga Impact to a Z-Move.
Once per battle for the team, Snorlax's Giga Impact becomes Pulverizing Pancake: 210-power Normal damage. Not used up.
Soda Pop: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.
Soft Sand: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A loose, silky sand that boosts the power of Ground-type moves.
Solganium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Solgaleo's Sunsteel Strike to a Z-Move.
Once per battle for the team, Solgaleo or Dusk Mane Necrozma's Sunsteel Strike becomes Searing Sunraze Smash: 200-power Steel damage that ignores abilities. Not used up.
Soothe Bell: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A bell with a comforting chime that makes the holder calm and friendly.
Soul Dew: An orb to be held by a Latios or Latias. Raises the power of Psychic and Dragon-type moves.
Latias's and Latios's Dragon and Psychic moves do 1.2× damage.
Spell Tag: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A sinister, eerie tag that boosts Ghost-type moves.
Star Piece: A shard of a pretty gem that sparkles in a red color. It can be sold at a high price.
Stardust: A pretty red sand with a loose, silky feel. It can be sold at a high price.
Stat Scanner: This special device can analyze the EVs and IVs of a Pokémon in your party.
Steel Gem: A gem with an essence of steel. When held, it strengthens the power of a Steel-type move once.
The first damaging Steel move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up.
Steelium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Steel-type moves to Z-Moves.
Steelixite: Have Steelix hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Sun Stone: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as red as the sun.
Super Potion: A spray-type wound medicine. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.
Super Repel: Prevents weak wild Pokémon from appearing for 200 steps.
Super Rod: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild Pokémon.
Swampertite: Have Swampert hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Tanga Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Bug-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Bug hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Tapunium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades the tapu's Nature's Mad to a Z-Move.
Once per battle for the team, a Tapu's Nature's Madness becomes Guardian of Alola: removes 3/4 of the target's current HP. Not used up.
Tea: An aromatic tea prepared by an old lady. It will slake even the worst thirst.
Terrain Extender: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the terrain duration of the holder's move or ability.
Terrain started by the holder lasts 8 turns instead of 5. Switching out does not shorten it.
Thick Club: A hard bone of some sort to be held by a Cubone or Marowak. It raises the Attack stat.
Doubles Cubone's and Marowak's Attack, including Alolan Marowak.
Throat Spray: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It raises Sp. Atk when a Pokémon uses a sound-based move.
After the holder successfully uses a sound move, raises Sp. Atk by 1 stage. Used up; works with sound-based status moves too.
ThunderStone: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a thunderbolt pattern.
Timer Ball: A somewhat different Ball that becomes progressively better the more turns there are in a battle.

TinyMushroom: A small and rare mushroom. It is quite popular among certain people.
Toxic Orb: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a bizzare orb that badly poisons the holder in battle.
Badly poisons the holder at each turn's end if it has no status and can be poisoned. Poison Heal restores 1/8 max HP each turn instead of poison damage. Not used up.
Toxtricitite: Have Toxtricity hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Tri-Pass: A pass for ferries between One, Two, and Three Island. It has a drawing of three islands.
Twisted Spoon: An item to be held by a Pokémon. A spoon imbued with telekinetic power boosts Psychic-type moves.
Tyranitarite: Have Tyranitar hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Ultra Ball: A very high-grade Ball that offers a higher Pokémon catch rate than a Great Ball.
Ultranecrozium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Necrozma's Photon Geyser to a Z-Move.

Upgrade: A transparent device filled with all sorts of data. It is made by Silph Co.
Held by Porygon-Z: Speed ×1.5, but it can't use the same move twice in a row.
Venusaurite: Have Venusaur hold this, and this stone will enable it to Mega Evolve during battle.
Wacan Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Electric-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Electric hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.
Water Gem: A gem with an essence of water. When held, it strengthens the power of a Water-type move once.
The first damaging Water move does 1.5× damage; the gem is used up.
Water Stone: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear light blue.
Waterium Z: This is a crystallized form of Z-Power. It upgrades Water-type moves to Z-Moves.
Once per battle for the team, turns a Water attack into Hydro Vortex (power depends on the move), or adds a Water status move's Z bonus. Deals 1/4 damage through Protect. Not used up.
Weakness Policy: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Atk and Sp. Atk. increase if it is hit with a move it's weak to.
After surviving a super-effective hit, raises Attack and Sp. Atk by 2 stages each. Used up; can activate between hits of a multi-hit move.
Wellspring Mask: A carved mask that when held by Ogerpon allows it to wield the Water type and boosts its power by 20%.
Wepear Berry: Can be ground up into a powder as an ingredient for medicine.
White Herb: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It restores any lowered stat in battle. It can be used only once.
Restores all negative stat stages to 0, then is used up. Keeps positive stages; clears both Defense drops from Shell Smash at once.
Wide Lens: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is a magnifying lens that boosts the accuracy of moves.
Wise Glasses: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This thick pair of glasses slightly boosts the power of special moves.
Wishing Piece: Throw one into a Pokémon Den to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.
Yache Berry: If held, reduces damage taken from one super effective Ice-move.
Halves the damage of one super-effective Ice hit. Eaten before that hit; protects against only one hit of a multi-hit move.

Yellow Shard: A small yellow shard. It appears to be from some sort of a tool made long ago.
Z-Power Ring: A mysterious ring that enables the use of Z-Power. It requires the willpower of the trainer wearing it.
Zinc: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Sp. Def stat of one Pokémon.
